technique_name: Compare and Contrast JavaScript and Python
description:
JavaScript and Python are both high-level programming languages used in developing web applications. 

JavaScript is a scripting language that is based in C, but has an improved syntax and is event-driven. It is used to create dynamic user interfaces and add interactive elements to web pages. It is also often used to communicate with back-end databases. On the other hand, Python is a general-purpose programming language that is high-level and object-oriented.
